summary: The bug report's claim reproduces through the real checkout path. One cart with OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3 (both using the shared WIDGET item, 12 units needed vs 10 stocked) completed successfully in all 13 runs, leaving WIDGET reserved at 12 against stock of 10. no_oversell failed in every run. The cause is in ensureInventoryLevels in the inventory service, which checks each batch entry against the same un-decremented available quantity, and complete-cart sends one entry per line item with no aggregation. I did not directly read the ensureInventoryLevels source (the tool returned errors), so the code-level attribution rests on the report and the observed behavior.
